models.name: erp_time_track_guests
models.description:
Temporary guest accounts identified by device for unauthenticated access to sign-up functionality.

Guest accounts represent anonymous users accessing the platform without registration. They are identified by device fingerprints or session tokens and have limited access compared to registered members. Guest accounts cannot perform business operations but can access sign-up flows and public information.

{@link erp_time_track_guest_sessions.id} references sessions for this guest account.

plainFields.name: device_identification
plainFields.description: Unique device identifier or fingerprint used to recognize guest sessions across multiple visits. This could be a browser fingerprint, device ID, or session token.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was soft-deleted, if applicable. Null indicates the account is active.

models.name: erp_time_track_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest access without authentication credentials.

This table tracks guest sessions initiated by unauthenticated users accessing sign-up functionality. Each session records connection context including IP address, referrer URL, and the specific page accessed. Sessions have a finite lifespan controlled by the expired_at timestamp, after which they can no longer be used for guest operations.

Guest sessions differ from authenticated sessions in that they require no login credentials and have limited permissions, primarily focused on account creation and initial platform exploration. The system automatically manages session expiration to prevent indefinite guest access.

{@link erp_time_track_guests}

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_guest_id
foreignFields.description: Associated guest actor's {@link erp_time_track_guests.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client device that initiated the session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL or path accessed when the session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header value indicating the previous page visited.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session was initiated.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session becomes invalid and can no longer be used.

models.name: erp_time_track_members
models.description:
Registered user accounts with email/password credentials for authentication.

Members are authenticated users who can belong to multiple organizations via Employee associations. Each member has a global personal profile including display name, avatar image, and phone number that is shared across all organizations they belong to.

When logging in, members select which organization to work in (organization context), with all subsequent actions scoped to the selected organization. Members can switch organizations without logging out. Members can delete their account, but if they are the sole owner of an organization, they must transfer ownership or delete the organization first.

Member sessions are tracked in {@link erp_time_track_member_sessions}, and password reset functionality is managed through {@link erp_time_track_member_password_resets}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for authentication and communication. Used as login identifier and for sending password reset notifications.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's preferred display name shown across the platform.

plainFields.name: avatar_url
plainFields.description: URL to the user's profile avatar image.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: User's phone number for contact purposes.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for authentication security.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account status indicating if the member is active, deactivated, or deleted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was soft-deleted, or null if active.

models.name: erp_time_track_member_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens with access and refresh tokens for authenticated member users, supporting organization context.

Each session represents a logged-in member user's authentication state, including the access and refresh tokens for API authorization. Sessions include organization context selection for members who belong to multiple organizations, allowing them to work within a specific organizational scope without re-authentication.

Sessions automatically expire based on the expired_at timestamp, requiring users to refresh their tokens or re-authenticate. This table supports the multi-organization membership model where users can switch between organizations seamlessly while maintaining their authentication state.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticated member user who owns this session. {@link erp_time_track_members.id}

foreignFields.name: current_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Currently selected organization context for this session. Allows members who belong to multiple organizations to work within a specific organizational scope. {@link erp_time_track_organizations.id}

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token for API authorization. Encoded as a JSON Web Token containing user identity and permissions. Must be validated on each authenticated request.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens without re-authentication. Used when access tokens expire to maintain session continuity.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from which the session was initiated. Used for security auditing and suspicious activity detection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the page where the session was created. Useful for tracking user entry points and session context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header from the request that created the session. Indicates the previous page the user visited before authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created. Sessions are created upon successful user authentication.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and becomes invalid. After this time, the access token can no longer be used and requires refresh or re-authentication.

models.name: erp_time_track_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for member account password recovery.

Stores temporary tokens that allow members to reset forgotten passwords. Each token is uniquely generated and expires after a configurable period (typically 24 hours). Tokens are single-use and invalidated after successful password reset.

The table tracks token usage status and expiration to ensure security. Expired or used tokens should be periodically cleaned up to maintain database performance.

This table supports the authentication flow defined in requirements, allowing members to recover access to their accounts when passwords are forgotten.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who requested password reset. {@link erp_time_track_members.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token generated for the member. Used in reset URL for verification.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token expires and becomes invalid. Typically set to 24 hours after creation.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was successfully used to reset the password. Null indicates the token has not been used yet.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token record was last updated.

models.name: erp_time_track_admins
models.description:
Organization owner accounts with email/password credentials for administrative authentication. Admins are the primary owners of organizations with full administrative access to all features and settings.

Each admin account represents a user with complete control over a specific organization. Admins can manage organization settings, create custom roles, invite employees, and oversee all business operations within their organization. The admin authentication is separate from member authentication to maintain clear security boundaries.

This table stores the authentication credentials and ownership relationships for organization administrators. Admins reference their owned organization via {@link erp_time_track_organizations.id} and have associated sessions and password reset records for authentication lifecycle management.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address for admin authentication. Must be unique across all admin accounts and used for login and password recovery.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication. Stored using industry-standard cryptographic hashing algorithms.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created. Recorded automatically during initial organization setup.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was last updated. Automatically updated on any modification to the record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was soft-deleted. Null indicates the account is active. When an admin deletes their account, this field is set to mark the account as inactive while preserving historical data.

models.name: erp_time_track_admin_sessions

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged admin's {@link erp_time_track_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: current_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Currently selected organization context for session operations. {@link erp_time_track_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token for API authentication during this session.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens when current one expires.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client device that created this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL of the page where the session was created.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referring URL that directed the user to the session creation page.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expires and becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was manually revoked or terminated.

models.name: erp_time_track_admin_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for admin account password recovery with expiration security.

This table stores secure, time-limited tokens used for admin password reset flows. Each token is cryptographically generated, associated with a specific admin account, and expires after a security window to prevent unauthorized access. Tokens are single-use and automatically invalidated after consumption or expiration.

Tokens are generated when admins initiate password recovery and consumed when they complete the password change process. The expiration mechanism ensures security compliance while the used flag prevents token reuse attacks. All password reset operations are audited through this table's temporal tracking fields.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the admin account initiating password reset. {@link erp_time_track_admins.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Cryptographically secure password reset token used for authentication in password recovery flow.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp when the token becomes invalid for security compliance.

plainFields.name: used
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the token has been consumed for password reset.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was generated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was soft-deleted for audit purposes.

models.name: erp_time_track_organizations
models.description:
Main organization entity representing an isolated multi-tenant container that scopes all business operations. Each organization operates independently with its own employees, projects, and data. Organizations have settings including currency, timezone, and fiscal configuration that affect all business logic within the container. The organization owner has full administrative control.

Organizations support complete data isolation between different companies using the platform. All subsequent entities (employees, projects, timelogs, etc.) are scoped to a specific organization through foreign key relationships. Organization deletion requires resolution of all pending timesheets and active employee contracts.

This table serves as the root of the multi-tenant architecture, establishing the data isolation boundaries that ensure complete separation between different business entities using the platform.

foreignFields.name: owner_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Organization owner with full administrative control. {@link erp_time_track_admins.id}

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Organization name for identification and display purposes.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Brief description of the organization's purpose or industry.

plainFields.name: logo_image_uri
plainFields.description: URI to the organization's logo image file for branding.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current operational status of the organization. Values: 'active' - fully operational, 'suspended' - temporarily inactive, 'deleted' - permanently removed but preserved for data retention.

plainFields.name: currency_code
plainFields.description: Currency code for financial operations (ISO 4217 format, e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'KRW').

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: Primary timezone for the organization (IANA timezone format, e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Asia/Seoul').

plainFields.name: fiscal_start_month
plainFields.description: Month number (1-12) when the organization's fiscal year begins.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization was soft-deleted, null if active.

models.name: erp_time_track_organization_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time snapshots of organization data for audit and historical tracking.

This table captures the complete state of an organization at specific moments in time, preserving historical configurations and settings for compliance, audit trails, and change tracking. Each snapshot represents a frozen view of the organization's attributes including name, description, currency, timezone, fiscal configuration, and visual identity.

Snapshots are created whenever significant changes occur to organization settings or periodically for compliance requirements. They provide an immutable historical record that cannot be modified after creation, ensuring audit integrity and supporting data recovery scenarios.

{@link erp_time_track_organizations.id}

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the organization whose state is captured in this snapshot. {@link erp_time_track_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Organization name as recorded at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Organization description as recorded at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Preferred currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, KRW) for financial operations at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: Primary timezone identifier (e.g., America/New_York, Asia/Seoul) for scheduling at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: fiscal_start_month
plainFields.description: Month (1-12) marking the start of the organization's fiscal year at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: logo_url
plainFields.description: URL to the organization logo image as stored at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created, marking the point-in-time capture moment.

models.name: erp_time_track_organization_settings
models.description:
Organization-specific configuration settings that extend beyond basic organizational attributes. This table stores settings that are truly supplementary to the core organization data defined in the parent table. Each organization has exactly one settings record for extended configuration needs.

Note: Core organization attributes like currency_code, timezone, fiscal_start_month, and logo are already stored in the parent {@link erp_time_track_organizations} table and should not be duplicated here.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization that owns these extended settings. {@link erp_time_track_organizations.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when these settings were created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when these settings were last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when these settings were soft deleted. Null if active.

models.name: erp_time_track_custom_roles

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization that owns this custom role. Custom roles are organization-specific and cannot be shared across organizations. {@link erp_time_track_organizations.id}

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique name of the custom role within the organization. Must be distinct from other custom role names in the same organization and from built-in role names (Owner, Manager, Employee). Used for identification in UI and reporting.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description explaining the purpose and intended use of this custom role. Can include information about which job functions or positions should receive this role, or any special considerations for its use.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this custom role was created. Recorded automatically at creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this custom role was last modified. Updated automatically whenever the role name, description, or permission assignments are changed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this custom role was soft-deleted. Null indicates the role is active. Custom roles can only be deleted when no employees are assigned to them. Deletion removes the role definition permanently but does not affect historical activity logs.

models.name: erp_time_track_custom_role_snapshots
models.description:
Historical point-in-time snapshots of custom role definitions for audit trail and compliance tracking.

Captures the complete state of custom roles at specific moments, preserving the exact role name, description, and organizational context as they existed when the snapshot was taken. These records are append-only and immutable, providing an auditable history of role configuration changes over time.

Used for compliance verification, change tracking, and historical analysis of role evolution within the organization. Each snapshot references the specific custom role it documents via {@link erp_time_track_custom_roles.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_custom_role_id
foreignFields.description: The custom role being snapshotted. References {@link erp_time_track_custom_roles.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: The exact name of the custom role as it existed when the snapshot was taken.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: The full description of the custom role's purpose and scope at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The date and time when this snapshot was created, establishing the historical point-in-time reference.

models.name: erp_time_track_role_permissions
models.description:
Granular permissions available for assignment to custom roles within an organization. Each permission defines a specific capability that can be granted to users through role assignments.

Permissions are organization-specific to support custom permission sets. The permission code follows a standardized format (e.g., 'org:manage', 'employee:view') that corresponds to specific system capabilities. This table serves as the reference lookup for all available permission definitions within an organization context.

Permissions from this table are assigned to {@link erp_time_track_custom_roles} through junction relationships to create complete role definitions with specific permission sets.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization that owns this permission definition. {@link erp_time_track_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique permission identifier following standardized format (e.g., 'org:manage', 'employee:view', 'project:manage'). Used as a stable reference in authorization logic.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the permission for display purposes (e.g., 'Manage Organization', 'View Employees').

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of what this permission grants to users, including scope and limitations.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Functional category grouping for permissions (e.g., 'organization', 'employee', 'project', 'time', 'report').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission definition was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission definition was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission definition was soft-deleted. Null indicates active permission.

models.name: erp_time_track_role_permission_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time snapshots of role permission assignments for audit and historical tracking.

This table captures the complete state of role permission assignments whenever changes occur, providing an immutable audit trail for compliance and historical analysis. Each snapshot records the permission assignment configuration between a custom role and a specific permission, including the organization context and assignment metadata.

Snapshots are automatically created whenever role permission assignments are created, modified, or deleted. The historical record enables tracking permission evolution over time and supports compliance reporting requirements.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_role_permission_id
foreignFields.description: The role permission assignment being snapshotted. {@link erp_time_track_role_permissions.id}.

foreignFields.name: custom_role_id
foreignFields.description: The custom role to which the permission is assigned. {@link erp_time_track_custom_roles.id}.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization context for this role permission assignment. {@link erp_time_track_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: permission_key
plainFields.description: The specific permission key being assigned to the role, such as 'org:manage', 'employee:view', etc.

plainFields.name: assigned_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this permission was originally assigned to the role.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was soft-deleted, or null if active.

models.name: erp_time_track_employees
models.description:
Employees represent user-organization associations with specific roles, departments, and employment terms within an organization. This table connects users (members) to organizations, defining their role, department assignment, employment type, and status within that specific organizational context.

Each employee record exists within exactly one organization's data isolation boundary and belongs to exactly one user account. An employee can have different roles, departments, and employment types across different organizations through separate employee records. Employee status controls whether they can perform actions within the system, with deactivated employees preserving historical data but unable to log time or submit timesheets.

Historical changes to employee role assignments and department assignments are tracked in separate history tables {@link erp_time_track_employee_role_histories} and {@link erp_time_track_employee_department_histories}. Audit snapshots are maintained in {@link erp_time_track_employee_snapshots}.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: The organization this employee belongs to. Each employee exists within exactly one organization's data isolation boundary. {@link erp_time_track_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: The user account associated with this employee record. The member represents the global user identity that can belong to multiple organizations through separate employee records. {@link erp_time_track_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: custom_role_id
foreignFields.description: The role assigned to this employee within the organization. Each employee has exactly one role that defines their permissions and capabilities. {@link erp_time_track_custom_roles.id}.

foreignFields.name: department_id
foreignFields.description: Optional department assignment for organizational structure. Employees can belong to at most one department at a time, providing functional grouping within the organization. {@link erp_time_track_departments.id}.

plainFields.name: employment_type
plainFields.description: Classification of the employee's work arrangement within the organization. Determines reporting, payroll considerations, and potentially business rules around working hours and benefits.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the employee is currently participating in organizational activities. Active employees can log time, submit timesheets, and perform work-related actions. Deactivated employees preserve historical data but cannot perform actions.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Optional job title or position description within the organization. Provides additional context for organizational structure and reporting without predefined values.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this employee record was created. Represents when the user-organization association was established.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this employee record was last updated. Tracks modifications to role, department, employment type, position, or status.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this employee record was soft-deleted. Null indicates active record. Enables historical preservation while removing from active operations.

models.name: erp_time_track_contracts
models.description:
Employment contracts defining compensation terms, pay periods, and working arrangements for employees within an organization.

Each contract specifies the employment terms for an employee, including pay rate, working hours, and duration. Employees can have multiple contracts over time, but only one contract can be active at a time. Creating a new contract automatically ends the previous active contract by setting its end date to the day before the new contract starts.

Contracts are managed by users with `employee:manage` permission and serve as immutable historical records once ended. They are foundational for payroll calculations, time tracking compliance, and employment record keeping.

{@link erp_time_track_employees.id} {@link erp_time_track_member_sessions.id} {@link erp_time_track_admin_sessions.id}

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_employee_id
foreignFields.description: The employee this contract belongs to. Only one contract can be active per employee at any given time. {@link erp_time_track_employees.id}

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: The date when this contract becomes effective. Must be provided and cannot be in the future relative to contract creation.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: The date when this contract ends, if applicable. Null indicates an ongoing contract with no specified end date. When a new contract is created for the same employee, this is automatically set to the day before the new contract's start date.

plainFields.name: pay_rate
plainFields.description: The compensation amount per pay period, expressed as a decimal number. For hourly pay periods, this is the hourly rate; for monthly, this is the monthly salary.

plainFields.name: pay_period
plainFields.description: The frequency of payment for this contract. Must be one of: 'hourly', 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly'.

plainFields.name: working_hours_per_week
plainFields.description: The expected number of working hours per week for full-time equivalence. Used for overtime calculations and compliance tracking.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional notes or special terms associated with this contract, such as specific allowances, bonuses, or conditions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this contract record was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this contract record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this contract record was soft-deleted, allowing for data recovery if needed. Null indicates the contract is active.

models.name: erp_time_track_departments
models.description:
Organizational departments providing structure for grouping employees within an organization. Departments support one level of nesting with optional parent-child relationships for organizational hierarchy.

Departments serve as functional divisions or teams within a company structure. When a department is deleted, all employee references to that department are automatically cleared while preserving employee records. Departments are scoped to a specific organization and cannot be shared across organizational boundaries.

Each department has a unique name within its organization to ensure clear identification. The optional parent department reference enables simple two-level hierarchy for organizational reporting structures.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged organization's {@link erp_time_track_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: parent_department_id
foreignFields.description: Parent department's {@link erp_time_track_departments.id} for one-level hierarchy. Null for root-level departments.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Department name identifier describing function or purpose within the organization.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Additional information about department responsibilities, scope, and function.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when department record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when department record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when department was soft-deleted. Null indicates active department.

models.name: erp_time_track_employee_role_histories
models.description:
Tracks historical role assignments for employees, recording when roles were assigned or changed within an organization. This table provides a complete audit trail of role transitions, including attribution of who made each change and the specific dates of role assignments. Each entry represents a single role assignment event, whether initial assignment or subsequent change.

Key business purpose: Maintains compliance records for role-based access control changes, supports investigation of permission escalations, and provides historical context for employee capability evolution within the organization.

When an employee's role is assigned or changed through employee management operations, a new record is created in this table. The record captures the employee, the assigned role, who authorized the change, and when it took effect.

Related entities: {@link erp_time_track_employees} (the employee whose role changed), {@link erp_time_track_custom_roles} or built-in roles (the assigned role), {@link erp_time_track_admins} or {@link erp_time_track_members} (who made the change).

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_employee_id
foreignFields.description: The employee whose role assignment is being recorded. This references the specific employee record within the organization where the role change occurred. {@link erp_time_track_employees.id}

foreignFields.name: role_id
foreignFields.description: The role assigned to the employee. References either a custom role defined within the organization or a built-in role identifier. {@link erp_time_track_custom_roles.id}

foreignFields.name: previous_role_id
foreignFields.description: The previous role held by the employee before this change, if applicable. Null for initial role assignments where there was no previous role. {@link erp_time_track_custom_roles.id}

plainFields.name: change_type
plainFields.description: Type of role change: 'assignment' (initial role assignment), 'reassignment' (role change), or 'removal' (role removal). Indicates the nature of the role transition event.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who made the role change: 'admin' or 'member'. Determines which subtype table contains the specific actor reference.

plainFields.name: effective_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when the role change took effect. This determines when the employee's permissions were updated to match the new role.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Optional reason or justification for the role change, such as promotion, department transfer, or organizational restructuring. Provides context for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this role history record was created. Automatically set when the role change is recorded in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this role history record was last updated. Automatically updated on modifications.

models.name: erp_time_track_employee_department_histories
models.description:
Historical records tracking department assignment changes for employees within an organization.

Captures when an employee was assigned to a specific department and when that assignment ended. Supports organizational structure analysis, employee movement tracking, and historical reporting of department affiliations. Each record represents a contiguous period of time during which an employee was assigned to a particular department.

Created automatically when employees change departments via employee management operations. Used primarily for audit trails, historical reporting, and understanding organizational structure evolution over time.

models.name: erp_time_track_employee_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time snapshots of employee data for audit and historical preservation.

This table captures the complete state of employee records at specific moments, including all employment details, role assignments, and department relationships. Snapshots are created whenever significant changes occur to employee data, such as role changes, department transfers, or employment status updates.

Each snapshot references the original employee record via {@link erp_time_track_employees.id} and includes denormalized data from related entities like roles and departments to preserve historical context even if those referenced entities are later modified or deleted.

These snapshots serve compliance requirements by maintaining immutable records of employment terms and organizational assignments over time. Access parent employee data via the foreign key relationship, never by duplicating parent fields.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Original employee record that this snapshot captures. {@link erp_time_track_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_custom_role_id

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_department_id
foreignFields.description: Department assignment at snapshot time. {@link erp_time_track_departments.id}.

plainFields.name: employment_type
plainFields.description: Employment classification type at snapshot time (full-time, part-time, contractor, intern).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Employee status at snapshot time (active, deactivated).

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Job title or position description at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: snapshot_reason
plainFields.description: Business reason for creating this snapshot (role change, department transfer, status update, etc.).

models.name: erp_time_track_contract_snapshots
models.description:
Historical snapshots of employment contracts capturing point-in-time state for audit trails and compliance verification.

Each snapshot preserves the exact terms of a contract at a specific moment, including working hours specification, pay rate and period, and employment dates. This immutable record supports payroll accuracy verification, regulatory compliance audits, and historical analysis of employment arrangements.

Snapshots are created whenever contract terms are modified, ensuring a complete audit trail of employment relationship changes. The denormalized structure allows direct historical reference without requiring access to the original contract record.

Related to: {@link erp_time_track_contracts} (original contract), {@link erp_time_track_employees} (employed individual).

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_contract_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the original contract being snapshotted. {@link erp_time_track_contracts.id}.

plainFields.name: working_hours_per_week
plainFields.description: Expected weekly workload specification as defined in the contract. This value establishes baseline employment expectations and informs overtime calculations and compliance tracking.

plainFields.name: pay_rate
plainFields.description: Compensation amount as specified in the contract. The exact numerical value forms the basis for payroll calculations and financial reporting.

plainFields.name: pay_period
plainFields.description: Frequency of compensation payments: hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly. Determines payroll processing intervals and calculation methods.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Effective start date of the employment terms. Marks when the contractual obligations and compensation arrangements become active.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Planned termination date of the employment terms, if applicable. Null indicates ongoing employment without specified end date.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Additional contextual information or special terms associated with the employment arrangement. May include bonus structures, special conditions, or contractual notes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created, capturing the exact moment of contract state preservation for audit trail purposes.

models.name: erp_time_track_employee_department_history_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time snapshots of employee department history for audit trail and historical state preservation.

This table captures immutable historical states of employee department assignments, providing a complete audit trail of organizational structure changes. Each snapshot records the exact department assignment details at a specific moment in time, including department reference, effective date range, and assignment reason.

When an employee's department assignment changes or is updated, a snapshot is created to preserve the historical state before modification. This supports compliance requirements, organizational reporting, and historical analysis of workforce structure evolution.

Related entities: {@link erp_time_track_employee_department_histories}, {@link erp_time_track_employees}, {@link erp_time_track_departments}

foreignFields.name: employee_department_history_id

plainFields.name: employee_id

plainFields.name: department_id
plainFields.description: Department the employee was assigned to. Denormalized from the original history record for audit integrity. {@link erp_time_track_departments.id}.

models.name: erp_time_track_employee_role_history_by_admins
models.description:
Links employee role change history records to the specific admin users who performed the role assignments or modifications.

This table provides an audit trail for role changes within the organization, connecting historical role assignments recorded in {@link erp_time_track_employee_role_histories} with the administrator accounts from {@link erp_time_track_admins} who authorized the changes. Role changes can only be performed by users with appropriate permissions (typically administrators with employee management privileges). Each entry represents a single role change action performed by an admin, recording both the historical role change event and the responsible administrator.

This audit trail supports compliance requirements, organizational transparency, and accountability tracking for role modifications within the human resources management system.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_employee_role_history_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the specific role change history entry. {@link erp_time_track_employee_role_histories.id}

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the admin account who performed the role change. {@link erp_time_track_admins.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this role change recording was created, indicating when the admin performed the role modification.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this role change recording was last updated, tracking modifications to the audit record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: erp_time_track_employee_role_history_by_members
models.description:
Links employee role history entries to the member users who performed the role changes.

This table establishes the connection between role change history records and the specific member accounts that initiated those changes. Each employee role change can be performed by either a member user or an admin user, tracked separately to maintain clear attribution. This table specifically handles changes made by members (non-admin users).

The record is created when a member user changes an employee's role assignment within the organization, and it serves as an audit trail for permission management actions. {@link erp_time_track_employee_role_histories.id} references the history entry being attributed, while {@link erp_time_track_members.id} identifies the member user who executed the change.

This table is part of the comprehensive audit system for employee role management, ensuring accountability and traceability of all role assignment modifications.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_employee_role_history_id
foreignFields.description: The role change history entry being attributed to a member user. {@link erp_time_track_employee_role_histories.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_member_id
foreignFields.description: The member user who performed the role change. {@link erp_time_track_members.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribution record was created, matching the role change execution time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribution record was last updated. Typically matches created_at as these records are immutable after creation.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribution record was soft deleted, allowing for audit trail preservation while marking the record as inactive.

models.name: erp_time_track_projects
models.description:
Main project entity representing work initiatives within an organization.

Projects organize work efforts with budgets, timelines, and visual identification. Each project has a status lifecycle (active, archived, completed) and can contain multiple tasks. Projects are assigned to employees through project memberships with specific roles (member or project-lead).

Budget hours track estimated vs actual time consumption, while start and end dates define the project timeline. Color codes provide visual identification in user interfaces. Projects are strictly scoped to their parent organization ensuring multi-tenancy data isolation.

Related entities: {@link erp_time_track_organizations} (parent organization), {@link erp_time_track_project_memberships} (employee assignments), {@link erp_time_track_tasks} (contained work items).

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Parent organization that owns this project. {@link erp_time_track_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: name

plainFields.name: description

plainFields.description: Current lifecycle status: 'active' (accepting time entries), 'archived' (historical reference only), or 'completed' (finished work).

plainFields.name: budget_hours
plainFields.description: Total estimated hours budgeted for the project. Null indicates no budget tracking.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Planned project start date for timeline reference.

plainFields.name: end_date

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: erp_time_track_project_snapshots

Point-in-time snapshots of project data for audit trail and historical reference.

Captures the complete state of a project at a specific moment in time, including all business fields denormalized from the main project entity. Used for auditing changes, historical analysis, and compliance reporting. Each snapshot is immutable and append-only, preserving the project's configuration, status, and timeline details as they existed when the snapshot was created.

This snapshot table includes denormalized copies of parent project fields including organization reference for complete audit trail. Fields are captured as they existed at snapshot creation time, enabling historical queries and change tracking.

{@link erp_time_track_projects}

models.name: erp_time_track_tasks
models.description:
Individual work units within projects representing specific assignments with status, priority, estimates, and due dates.

Tasks break down project work into manageable units that can be assigned to employees. Each task belongs to exactly one project and may optionally be assigned to an employee who is a member of that project. Tasks support hierarchical relationships with one level of nesting for subtasks.

Status progression follows: open → in-progress → completed → closed. Priority levels indicate urgency for scheduling and resource allocation. Estimated hours and due dates help with project planning and tracking.

Tasks are the foundation for time tracking, as employees log time against specific tasks. {@link erp_time_track_projects.id} {@link erp_time_track_employees.id}

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_project_id
foreignFields.description: The parent project containing this task. {@link erp_time_track_projects.id}

foreignFields.name: assigned_employee_id
foreignFields.description: The employee assigned to work on this task, must be a member of the parent project. {@link erp_time_track_employees.id}

foreignFields.name: parent_task_id
foreignFields.description: Parent task for hierarchical relationships (one-level nesting only). {@link erp_time_track_tasks.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short, descriptive title of the task summarizing the work to be done.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the task requirements, acceptance criteria, or context.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description:
Current progress state of the task.

Allowed values:
- 'open': New task, not yet started
- 'in-progress': Actively being worked on
- 'completed': Work finished, awaiting verification
- 'closed': Finalized and verified

Status changes are recorded in {@link erp_time_track_task_histories}.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description:
Urgency level for scheduling and resource allocation.

Allowed values:
- 'low': Minor importance, can be deferred
- 'medium': Standard priority
- 'high': Important, should be addressed soon
- 'urgent': Critical, requires immediate attention

plainFields.name: estimated_hours
plainFields.description: Estimated number of hours required to complete the task, used for planning and tracking project budgets.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Target completion date for this task.

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task was soft deleted, or null if active.

models.name: erp_time_track_task_histories
models.description:
Tracks historical status changes for tasks, recording audit trails of workflow transitions.

Each time a task's status changes (e.g., from 'open' to 'in-progress', or 'in-progress' to 'completed'), this table records the old status, new status, who made the change, and when it occurred. This provides a complete audit trail for task lifecycle management, enabling review of task progress over time and supporting compliance requirements.

These records are created automatically whenever task status updates occur and are typically read-only for audit purposes. The description field allows for optional notes about why the status change occurred, such as 'Task completed ahead of schedule' or 'Reopened due to new requirements'.

{@link erp_time_track_tasks} serve as the parent entities for these histories, with each task having multiple historical status change records. {@link erp_time_track_members} represent the users who performed the status changes, which may be task assignees, project leads, or managers with appropriate permissions.

Includes standard temporal fields for audit trail completeness: created_at records when the status change occurred, updated_at tracks any modifications to the history record, and deleted_at supports soft deletion for compliance purposes.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_task_id
foreignFields.description: Task whose status changed. {@link erp_time_track_tasks.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member user who performed the status change. {@link erp_time_track_members.id}.

plainFields.name: old_status
plainFields.description: Task status before the change occurred. Valid values correspond to task status lifecycle: 'open', 'in-progress', 'completed', 'closed'.

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: Task status after the change occurred. Valid values correspond to task status lifecycle: 'open', 'in-progress', 'completed', 'closed'.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of why the status change occurred, providing context for the workflow transition.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the status change was recorded. This serves as the audit trail timestamp for the historical record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this history record was last modified. Supports audit trail completeness for any corrections or annotations to historical status changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this history record was soft-deleted, supporting compliance and data retention requirements while preserving referential integrity.

models.name: erp_time_track_task_parent_children
models.description:
Hierarchical relationships between parent and child tasks, enforcing one-level nesting constraints.

This junction table establishes parent-child relationships between tasks within the same project. A task can have multiple child tasks (subtasks), and a child task can have only one parent, implementing a one-level nesting hierarchy as specified in requirements. The relationship is constrained to prevent circular references and ensure proper hierarchical structure.

Parent-child relationships are managed through task operations rather than directly, making this a supporting entity for the task hierarchy system. When tasks are deleted, their associated parent-child relationships are automatically removed via cascade constraints.

{@link erp_time_track_tasks.id}

foreignFields.name: parent_task_id
foreignFields.description: Parent task reference. {@link erp_time_track_tasks.id}

foreignFields.name: child_task_id
foreignFields.description: Child task reference. {@link erp_time_track_tasks.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the parent-child relationship was established.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the relationship was last modified.

models.name: erp_time_track_project_memberships
models.description:
Junction table linking employees to projects with specific roles within projects.

This table implements a many-to-many relationship between employees and projects, allowing employees to be assigned to multiple projects and projects to have multiple assigned employees. Each assignment includes a role that determines the employee's level of responsibility within that specific project.

**Project Roles:**
- **member**: Standard project participant who can work on tasks and log time within the project.
- **project-lead**: Project leader who can manage tasks within their assigned project in addition to standard member capabilities.

**Business Context:** Users with project management permission can assign employees to projects and set their roles. Project leads have task management permissions within their assigned projects. When an employee is removed from a project, the record is soft-deleted to preserve historical assignment data. {@link erp_time_track_employees.id} and {@link erp_time_track_projects.id}

foreignFields.description: Assigned employee's {@link erp_time_track_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: project_id
foreignFields.description: Project the employee is assigned to {@link erp_time_track_projects.id}.

plainFields.name: role

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: erp_time_track_timelogs
models.description:
Core time tracking records representing discrete units of work time spent by employees. Each timelog captures when work occurred, how long it took, what project/task it was for, and whether it is billable to clients. Timelogs serve as the fundamental building blocks for weekly timesheets and provide granular auditability for time accounting.

Timelogs are created by employees to record completed work sessions, with required association to a specific project and optional assignment to a task within that project. The date field records the calendar day when work occurred, while duration tracks time spent in minutes for precise measurement. The billable flag distinguishes revenue-generating work from internal operational activities.

Timelogs exist as independent records that can be aggregated into timesheets for approval workflows. They maintain traceability to the performing employee, project context, and organizational scope for comprehensive reporting and analysis.

foreignFields.name: employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who performed the recorded work. {@link erp_time_track_employees.id}

foreignFields.name: project_id
foreignFields.description: Project associated with the recorded work. Required for all timelogs. {@link erp_time_track_projects.id}

foreignFields.name: task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional task assignment within the associated project. {@link erp_time_track_tasks.id}

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization context for the timelog. Derived from employee relationship. {@link erp_time_track_organizations.id}

plainFields.name: date
plainFields.description: Calendar day when work was performed. Essential for weekly timesheet aggregation and chronological organization.

plainFields.name: duration_minutes
plainFields.description: Time spent on work in minutes. Provides precise measurement of work duration supporting partial hour calculations.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of work performed. Provides context beyond numerical time data, explaining nature and outcomes.

plainFields.name: billable
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the time should be considered chargeable to clients. Defaults to true for revenue-generating work.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timelog record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timelog record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timelog was soft-deleted. Allows historical preservation even if employee deactivated.

models.name: erp_time_track_timesheets
models.description:
Weekly time approval containers grouping timelogs for managerial review and formal time authorization.

Each timesheet aggregates an employee's time entries for a standard work week (Monday through Sunday) into a cohesive unit for review, approval, and payroll processing. Timesheets progress through a defined status lifecycle: draft (editable), submitted (pending review), approved (locked and finalized), or rejected (requiring revision).

Approved timesheets lock all included timelogs to preserve historical accuracy for payroll and compliance. Managers provide rejection reasons when returning timesheets for correction. The total hours field automatically calculates the sum of all included timelog durations.

Timesheets serve as the formal business container for time approval workflows, connecting individual time tracking to organizational time management. {@link erp_time_track_timesheet_approvals} records approval history, {@link erp_time_track_timesheet_timelogs} links timesheets to their constituent timelogs, and {@link erp_time_track_timesheet_snapshots} preserves historical states for audit purposes.

foreignFields.name: employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee who owns this timesheet. {@link erp_time_track_employees.id}

foreignFields.name: reviewed_by_id
foreignFields.description: Manager who reviewed and approved/rejected this timesheet. {@link erp_time_track_members.id}

plainFields.name: week_start_date
plainFields.description: Monday date marking the start of the weekly period this timesheet covers. Must be a Monday date.

plainFields.name: week_end_date
plainFields.description: Sunday date marking the end of the weekly period this timesheet covers. Must be exactly 6 days after week_start_date.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current approval status of the timesheet: draft (editable), submitted (pending review), approved (finalized), or rejected (needs correction).

plainFields.name: total_hours
plainFields.description: Sum of all timelog durations included in this timesheet, calculated in hours (including fractional hours). Automatically computed from linked timelogs.

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when the employee formally submitted this timesheet for approval. Null while in draft status.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Date and time when a manager completed review by approving or rejecting this timesheet. Null while pending review.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Text explanation provided by manager when rejecting a submitted timesheet, guiding the employee on required corrections.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timesheet record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timesheet record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timesheet was soft-deleted, enabling recovery while removing from active views.

models.name: erp_time_track_timers
models.description:
Real-time tracking sessions for live work time measurement.

Employees can start timers to track work time in real-time. Each employee can have at most one active timer at a time. Timers must be associated with a project and optionally a specific task. While running, employees can edit the timer's description, project, or task assignment. Timers can be stopped (converting to a timelog with calculated duration) or discarded without creating a timelog.

Timers integrate with the broader time tracking system through {@link erp_time_track_timer_to_timelog_conversions} when converted to timelogs and {@link erp_time_track_timer_histories} for lifecycle event auditing.

foreignFields.name: employee_id

foreignFields.name: project_id

foreignFields.name: task_id

plainFields.description: Current state of the timer. 'active' = running and tracking time, 'discarded' = stopped without creating timelog, 'completed' = stopped and converted to timelog.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer was started. Used to calculate duration when timer is stopped.

plainFields.name: stopped_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer was stopped (for completed or discarded timers). Null while timer is active.

plainFields.name: duration_minutes
plainFields.description: Calculated duration in minutes between started_at and stopped_at, rounded to nearest minute. Null while timer is active or discarded.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Description of work being performed during timer session. Can be edited while timer is active.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer was soft-deleted. Null indicates active record.

models.name: erp_time_track_timesheet_timelogs
models.description:
Junction table mapping timelogs to timesheets for many-to-many relationship.

This table enables the association of multiple timelogs with a single timesheet and allows timelogs to be included in multiple timesheet drafts before final submission. The relationship is essential for the timesheet approval workflow where employees can include or exclude timelogs from draft timesheets before submission.

Each record represents a specific timelog's inclusion in a specific timesheet. The unique constraint prevents duplicate associations, while proper indexing supports efficient queries for finding all timelogs in a timesheet or all timesheets containing a specific timelog.

Business context: When employees create draft timesheets, the system automatically includes all their timelogs for the week. They can then remove timelogs before submission, and this junction table tracks which timelogs are currently included in which timesheet. Once a timesheet is approved, its timelog associations become immutable for audit purposes.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_timesheet_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the containing timesheet. {@link erp_time_track_timesheets.id}

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_timelog_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the included timelog. {@link erp_time_track_timelogs.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this timelog was added to the timesheet.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this association was last modified.

models.name: erp_time_track_timer_histories
models.description: Historical records of timer lifecycle events including start, stop, and discard actions. Each entry records a significant timer event with precise timing, event type classification, actor, description, and created_at. Provide operational debugging, compliance auditing.

models.name: erp_time_track_timelog_snapshots
models.description:
Audit trail snapshots of timelog state for historical tracking and compliance.

This table captures point-in-time references to timelog states as immutable append-only records. Unlike traditional snapshots that duplicate data, these records maintain referential integrity by linking to the parent {@link erp_time_track_timelogs} while preserving the audit trail of when snapshots were created.

Each snapshot represents a moment when a timelog's state was captured for audit, compliance, or historical tracking purposes. Snapshots are immutable and cannot be modified after creation. They enable reconstruction of timelog history without denormalizing business data.

The table maintains organization context through the parent timelog's organization_id for proper multi-tenant data isolation and access control.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_timelog_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent timelog that this snapshot captures. {@link erp_time_track_timelogs.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization context for multi-tenant data isolation. Inherited from parent timelog for data access control. {@link erp_time_track_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: snapshot_reason
plainFields.description: Optional description of why this snapshot was created (e.g., 'audit_trail', 'compliance_check', 'manual_capture'). Helps categorize snapshot purposes for reporting.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created. Snapshots are immutable append-only records.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was last updated. Typically matches created_at for immutable snapshots but maintained for consistency.

models.name: erp_time_track_timesheet_snapshots
models.description:
Point-in-time snapshots of timesheet data for audit and historical tracking.

Captures the complete state of a timesheet at a specific moment, including all approval status information, totals, and metadata. Used for compliance auditing, change tracking, and historical reporting. Each snapshot represents an immutable record of how the timesheet appeared at the time of capture, preserving data even after the original timesheet is modified.

These snapshots are essential for maintaining an audit trail of timesheet approval workflows and ensuring compliance with time tracking regulations. They provide historical context for understanding how timesheet data has evolved over time.

{@link erp_time_track_timesheets}

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_timesheet_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent timesheet that this snapshot captures. {@link erp_time_track_timesheets.id}

plainFields.name: snapshot_reason
plainFields.description: Reason or trigger for creating this snapshot, such as 'status_change', 'approval', 'rejection', 'manual_capture', or 'system_audit'.

plainFields.name: employee_id
plainFields.description: Employee who owns the timesheet at snapshot time. Denormalized from parent timesheet for historical preservation. {@link erp_time_track_employees.id}

plainFields.name: week_start_date
plainFields.description: Start date of the timesheet week (Monday). Denormalized from parent timesheet.

plainFields.name: week_end_date
plainFields.description: End date of the timesheet week (Sunday). Denormalized from parent timesheet.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Timesheet status at snapshot time: 'draft', 'submitted', 'approved', or 'rejected'.

plainFields.name: total_hours
plainFields.description: Total hours recorded in the timesheet at snapshot time. Calculated from included timelogs.

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was submitted for approval. Null if not submitted at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was reviewed (approved/rejected). Null if not reviewed at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: reviewed_by
plainFields.description: User who reviewed the timesheet (member or admin). Null if not reviewed at snapshot time. {@link erp_time_track_members.id}

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided when rejecting a timesheet. Null if not rejected at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot record was last updated.

models.name: erp_time_track_weekly_summaries
models.description:
Weekly aggregated time statistics per employee for reporting and analysis.

This table stores pre-computed weekly summaries of employee time tracking data, providing performance metrics and billing insights. Each record represents one employee's time activity for a specific week (Monday to Sunday), including total hours, billable/non-billable breakdown, and project distribution.

Weekly summaries are used for:
- Employee performance reporting
- Billing and invoicing preparation
- Project budget utilization tracking
- Compliance and audit reporting

The data is aggregated from {@link erp_time_track_timelogs} and provides optimized query performance for time analysis across date ranges and employee groups. Summaries are recalculated when underlying timelogs change to ensure data consistency.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the employee whose weekly time is summarized. {@link erp_time_track_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization context for data isolation. {@link erp_time_track_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: week_start_date
plainFields.description: Start date of the weekly period (Monday). Used for weekly aggregation and reporting period identification.

plainFields.name: week_end_date
plainFields.description: End date of the weekly period (Sunday). Defines the inclusive end of the reporting period.

plainFields.name: total_hours
plainFields.description: Total hours worked during the week, aggregated from all timelogs. Represents sum of duration across all tracked time entries.

plainFields.name: billable_hours
plainFields.description: Hours marked as billable to clients or projects. Used for invoicing and revenue tracking.

plainFields.name: non_billable_hours
plainFields.description: Hours marked as non-billable (internal work, training, administrative tasks). Used for cost analysis and resource allocation.

plainFields.name: timelog_count
plainFields.description: Number of individual timelog entries aggregated into this weekly summary. Indicates granularity of time tracking.

plainFields.name: project_count
plainFields.description: Number of distinct projects worked on during the week. Measures project distribution and task switching frequency.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this weekly summary record was created. Used for audit trail and data freshness tracking.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this weekly summary record was last updated. Indicates when aggregated data was recalculated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this weekly summary was soft-deleted. Allows historical preservation while removing from active queries.

models.name: erp_time_track_project_time_totals
models.description:
Project time consumption tracking table that calculates budget vs actual time comparisons for reporting and analysis purposes.

This table stores aggregated time data for projects, comparing planned budget hours against actual hours logged. It serves as a denormalized summary for performance monitoring, budget utilization reporting, and project health analysis. The data is typically updated periodically (daily or weekly) to reflect current project time consumption patterns.

Key relationships include: project reference to the main project entity, potential linkage to weekly summaries and timelog aggregates. This table supports project budget reports showing utilization percentages and variance analysis.

foreignFields.name: project_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the project being tracked. {@link erp_time_track_projects.id}

plainFields.name: period_start
plainFields.description: Start date of the reporting period (e.g., Monday for weekly, 1st of month for monthly).

plainFields.name: period_end
plainFields.description: End date of the reporting period (e.g., Sunday for weekly, last day of month for monthly).

plainFields.name: period_type
plainFields.description: Type of reporting period: 'weekly' or 'monthly'. Determines aggregation logic.

plainFields.name: budget_hours
plainFields.description: Planned budget hours for the project during this period. Null indicates no budget set.

plainFields.name: actual_hours
plainFields.description: Actual hours logged against the project during this period. Calculated from timelogs.

plainFields.name: variance_hours
plainFields.description: Difference between budget and actual hours (actual - budget). Positive indicates over budget.

plainFields.name: utilization_percentage
plainFields.description: Percentage of budget consumed (actual / budget * 100). Null when budget_hours is zero or null.

plainFields.name: calculated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this summary was last calculated and updated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated.

models.name: erp_time_track_timer_to_timelog_conversions
models.description:
Records the conversion of timer sessions to completed timelog entries.

When an employee stops a running timer, the system converts the timer session into a permanent timelog record. This table tracks that conversion process, linking the original timer to the resulting timelog. It captures conversion status, any errors encountered during the process, and provides an audit trail for timer-to-timelog transformations.

Each timer can have at most one conversion record, representing its successful or failed conversion to a timelog. Successful conversions create a permanent timelog entry for time tracking and reporting purposes, while failed conversions allow the system to log errors and potentially retry the conversion.

This table supports the timer lifecycle by documenting when timer sessions become part of the permanent time tracking record. {@link erp_time_track_timers} represent the source timer session, and {@link erp_time_track_timelogs} represent the resulting time log entry.

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_timer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the timer that was converted. {@link erp_time_track_timers.id}

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_timelog_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the resulting timelog created from the timer. {@link erp_time_track_timelogs.id}

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Conversion status indicating whether the timer was successfully converted to a timelog. Valid values: 'pending', 'converted', 'failed', 'discarded'.

plainFields.name: error_message
plainFields.description: Error message captured when conversion fails, providing details for troubleshooting.

plainFields.name: converted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer was converted to a timelog.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the conversion record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the conversion record was last updated.

models.name: erp_time_track_timesheet_approvals

foreignFields.name: erp_time_track_timesheet_id
foreignFields.description: The timesheet being reviewed. {@link erp_time_track_timesheets.id}

foreignFields.name: reviewer_id
foreignFields.description: The user who performed the timesheet review. {@link erp_time_track_members.id}

plainFields.name: decision
plainFields.description: The review decision: 'approved' or 'rejected'. Determines whether the timesheet was accepted or returned for correction.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Explanation provided when rejecting a timesheet, required when decision is 'rejected'. Should clearly indicate what needs correction.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review decision was made. Used for auditing and timeline analysis.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this approval record was created. Used for system auditing.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this approval record was last updated. Used for system auditing.
